en: A rectangular printed postcard with beige background and black text in Estonian. In the upper left corner there is a diamond‑shaped logo containing the words "Areng Tallinn". On the right side near the top it reads "Tallinnas, novembris 1925". The body consists of a formal letter promoting or describing a publication called "Romaan". Handwritten numbers appear in pencil at the top right edge.
